source.name: RTS: Kompanija "Mozzart" novi generalni sponzor KK Partizan
source.quote: Kompanija "Mozzart" novi je generalni i naslovni sponzor Košarkaškog kluba Partizan, pa će klub iz Humske od danas zvanično nositi ime "Partizan Mozzart Bet".
source.note: General and title sponsor since October 2022 (the club has played as Partizan Mozzart Bet since). The MOZZART wordmark sits mid-front on the 2026/27 home jersey, under the club name (official club store product photos, kkpartizanshop.com).

source.name: NIS: Nastavak saradnje NIS-a i Košarkaškog kluba „Partizan“
source.quote: Kompanija NIS i Košarkaški klub „Partizan“ nastavili su danas višegodišnje partnerstvo potpisivanjem novog ugovora o sponzorstvu.
source.note: Multi-year sponsorship contract, renewed in October 2022. The NIS logo sits on the front of the 2026/27 home jersey, under Mozzart (official club store product photos, kkpartizanshop.com).

source.name: KK Partizan official store: Dres "KK Partizan 2026/27", beli (product photos)
source.note: Image-only evidence: the club store's 2026/27 home-jersey product photos show the AikBank logo on the right chest, under the Nike swoosh (photos served with the page's product data; product published 21 September 2026). Opened and viewed by scout-review-987 on 2026-10-01 (no `checked` block because the page has no text to quote). No text announcement of the placement found.

source.name: RTS: Црно-бело вече под Авалским торњем (Partizan kit launch, back sponsor Changan)
source.quote: Нови дресови долазе у две класичне варијанте - белој и црној, без превише детаља, а на полеђини се налази и нови спонзор - кинеска аутомобилска компанија Чанган.
source.note: RTS at the 2025/26 kit launch: the new sponsor Changan is on the back ('na poleđini se nalazi i novi sponzor'). The 2026/27 jersey keeps the same layout — CHANGAN above the back number — visible in the club store's product photos (kkpartizanshop.com).

source.name: MaxBet Sport (max-sport.rs): Da li ste primetili? Novi dres Partizan krije poruku
source.quote: Partizan je predstavio i nove dresove u proizvodnji prestižne sportske opreme „Najk“.
source.note: Nike manufactures the 2026/27 playing kit (swoosh on the right chest). RTS (28 August 2025, rts.rs/sport/kosarka/evroliga/5778693) reported a six-year Nike contract signed until 2031.

summary: Partizan's 2026/27 home jersey (Nike) carries the club name in script across the chest, with the AikBank logo on the right chest and MOZZART above NIS mid-front; CHANGAN sits above the number on the back, above the BELGRADE lettering. The hem patch quotes the fan anthem 'Nek' ne igra ko se lomi' (kit design, not a sponsor). Every placement on the jersey is checked against the official club store's 2026/27 product photos (kkpartizanshop.com); no other sponsor appears on it.
